objective: Reduce retrieval latency and temporary allocations for large indexes while preserving exact ordered search results.
acceptance: Baseline and candidate produce exactly equal ordered hits, scores, and provenance for representative queries.
Stable tie ordering, score accumulation order, zero-frequency key behavior, and search limits remain covered.
Paired measurements cover a 20,000-line synthetic corpus and the repository corpus with latency and peak allocation recorded.
Full repository validation passes and release gates remain fail-closed.
